observations.why: Imperative directive performing a settled instruction the speaker expects compliance with — decision-grade by performed act, not merely an argued position.
Operational imperative with 'all' scoping — a performed declarative instructing erasure, not a position being argued for; decision requires the document to perform settling and this does.
Flat unhedged assertive stated as fact, but no ratification language or performed settling — a claim the speaker would defend, not a decision enacted here.
